devices.title: Devices

devices.removeDeviceConfirmation:
Are you sure you want to permanently remove device "{{name}}" from user {{username}}?

Note: This will only remove the device. The user can re-register it later.
Warning: If you want to prevent this device from connecting again, use "Remove & Blacklist" instead.

devices.blacklistDescription: Are you sure you want to add device "{{name}}" to the blacklist without removing it?\n\nNote: This will disconnect the device immediately but keep it in the active devices list until the user tries to reconnect.
devices.removeMultipleDescription: Are you sure you want to remove {{count}} selected devices?
devices.removeDeviceDescription:
Are you sure you want to remove "{{name}}"?

You will need to register this device again to use it in the future.
